question: E4B+MTP was the only config whose drafted mode could not reproduce ITSELF (4/6, 2026-09-27 survey). Attribute it: flash-attn? draft width? pins? cache?

method: 6-prompt suite run twice per config, E4B docker b11118, request temp 0.0, byte-compare A1 vs A2

finding: server-side '--temperature 0 --seed 42' on UPSTREAM-docker b1118 does not pin sampling — it BREAKS same-prompt reproducibility entirely (0/6 on every config incl. serial; outputs differ at style level). Without the server flags, request-level temp 0 is fully deterministic (6/6). The BONSAI FORK with the same server flags is byte-exact 6/6 (tonight + the survey) — the fork's sampler path honors the pins, upstream's does not
attribution_logic: FA on/off irrelevant (0/6 both), draft width irrelevant (d1 0/6), serial irrelevant (0/6 with pins) — the pins are the active ingredient
protocol_correction: for upstream-docker benches DO NOT pass server --temperature/--seed; pin at request level (temp 0) and keep cache_prompt consistent. Fork serves keep flags+env as before

finding: the ORIGINAL 4/6 (survey harness) used cache_prompt=TRUE and no pins: tonight's no-pins+cache-on = 5/6 — the cached-resumption class carries a 1-2/6 self-inconsistency on drafted E4B (slot-state reuse between identical requests is not bit-stable), while fresh prompts are clean 6/6. So the E4B 'mystery' was mostly the CACHE PATH class, not the drafter
note: morning-1.4's single-pair cached test showed determinism for one pair; across-suite repeats expose a 1/6 flip — refine 1.4's rule: the cached path is stable per-pair, weaker across repeated suites

impacted_rows: today's upstream-docker 'pinned' rows ran WITH the anti-pin flags: gemma-e4b-mtp-d3-c32k (7/11 @ 270 s), a3b-iq2xxs-v2-rebaseline (9/11), a3b-cram32 (8/11), xing4-official (4/11), pi-hunt MiMo serve (hunt itself unaffected — zero-byte detection is structural)
reading: those rows are still valid SCORES (sampling variance near argmax is small in practice — the pinned MiMo pair matched 7/11 per-task on 09-28), but they are NOT greedy-deterministic rows: treat as one-sample-of-N with the ±1 band, not as reproducible references. The E4B d3-vs-d2 'identical pass set' claim keeps its speed half (acceptance/decode physics) but its capability-neutrality half is now sample-luck-tempered
required_label_change: benchmarks/README pinned-era table now footnotes the anti-pin finding; NEXT-IDEAS determinism rules amended

verdict: 2.5 RESOLVED: mystery attributed to the cached-path class (5-4/6) + the anti-pin effect found and named; the E4B drafted-differently residual is CLOSED with two mechanisms identified; fork-vs-upstream sampler semantics recorded
